Quoting the quarter as the current observation when the half it sits inside is known and worse is not a neutral choice of period. The adopted 24.5% is therefore BELOW every one of the last four observations and the study prices the alternative explicitly rather than leaving the reader to find it. No statutory-vs-effective reconciliation is disclosed anywhere in the filings (Egyptian Accounting Standards do not require the IFRS-style table); the group operates in 15+ tax jurisdictions plus Free-Zone entities that pay 1% of revenue to GAFI instead of corporate tax. 24.5% sits between the FY2025 print and the historical average, allowing for the Q1-2026 uptick rather than extrapolating one low year

star_case.case: The market is capitalising earnings; this model says the earnings are not yet cash. On the model's own first forecast year free cash flow to the firm is NEGATIVE on NOPAT of about EGP 26bn, because revenue growing by a third absorbs working capital faster than the margin generates it. That single difference — the reinvestment charge — is where the whole disagreement lives, and it is why the cross-checks in this study that CAPITALISE earnings rather than discount cash sit at or above the traded price while the cash-flow lens does not. PRICED ALONE ON A FULL RE-RUN, TWO ASSUMPTIONS REACH THE MARKET AND THE REST DO NOT. The largest is all three segment margins permanently about 46% higher, back at FY2023-24 levels, worth EGP 113 a share against a central of 87.94 — 270% of the gap. Priced the same way and one at a time, copper a fifth above the escalated path is worth EGP 5.85 a share and a pound weaker than the house path EGP 2.34 — small beside the margin, because both pass through to cost and to working capital as well as to revenue. Section 1.9's currency row swings further, EGP 23.41 across a +/-15% band; that is a range on the whole path rather than this single re-run, and the two are not the same measurement. WHAT ARGUES AGAINST THAT MARGIN RECOVERY IS THE COMPANY'S OWN DISCLOSURE RATHER THAN OUR OPINION: cables revenue per tonne tracked copper and the pound almost exactly in FY2024 (+55.6% against +55.0%) and then failed to in FY2025 (+2.7% against +18.6%) — a measured pass-through shortfall of 15.9 points, computed from audited segment revenue and the company's own disclosed tonnage. The FY2023-24 margins were earned on inventory bought before a devaluation. A REPEAT REQUIRES THAT PRICING POWER TO RETURN, AND THE MOST RECENT FULL YEAR MEASURES IT LEAVING.
star_case.falsifier: TWO CONSECUTIVE REPORTED HALVES in which cables revenue per tonne grows at or above copper x the pound while volume holds — that is pricing power returning and this study is wrong about the margin. Equally: a group segment margin at or above 18%% for two consecutive full years. Either one and the market's read is the right one and this one is not.

e3.method_short: cash returns vs cost of capital

assert_log: SWDY — ASSERT / derivation log (rebuilt on the audited FY23-25 + Q1-2026 filings)

[Historical income statement] every FY2023-25 line is now the audited figure — no P&L closure or derivation is needed for any year, including FY2025, because the full filing is in hand. House EBITDA = operating profit + depreciation and amortisation: FY23 20,035, FY24 31,601, FY25 28,363 (10.09% of revenue). Effective tax rate: FY23 31.3%, FY24 30.1%, FY25 22.6%. This REPLACES a previous FY2025 EBITDA of 30,622 built by closing the P&L to two disclosed anchors (profit after tax and after minority) at an ASSUMED 25% effective rate and an ASSUMED -3,400 net finance cost; the actual audited figures (22.57% and -2,145) combine to a MATERIALLY LOWER house EBITDA of 28,363.

[Working capital, audited] FY23 36,655 (24.1% of revenue), FY24 53,495 (23.1%), FY25 55,853 (19.9%) — a genuine IMPROVEMENT in FY2025, not an assumption. Industrial real-estate-development land holdings (Note 24) are excluded as a separate quasi-investment item, consistent across all three years.

[FY2025 balance sheet] every line is the audited closing figure at 31 December 2025 — no triangulation is needed. Equity attributable to owners 66,871; gross loans and borrowings including leases 62,509; cash 41,949; net financial debt 20,560.

[Kd integrity] (i) CURRENCY COMPOSITION — audited FY2025 note rates: EGP 21.30%, hard-currency blend 5.29%. The blended effective rate implies an Egyptian-pound share of 28.4% and a hard-currency share of 71.6% — DOWN sharply from the roughly 44% pound share implied a year earlier, consistent with the FY2025-26 drawdown of hard-currency facilities (the Afreximbank USD 200mn line among them) to fund a growing hard-currency-linked working-capital book.
[Kd integrity] (ii) INDEPENDENT EFFECTIVE RATE — FY2025 interest expense on loans and credit facilities 5,967 / average balance 60,629 = 9.84%.
[Kd integrity] (iii) BOUNDS — adopted Kd 9.50%: within 150bp of the FY2025 effective rate (34bp) and does not exceed it by more than 50bp.

[Cost of equity] rf 22.31% less the sovereign default spread 3.40% = 18.91% (country risk out of the risk-free rate); + beta 1.225 x the MATURE-MARKET premium 4.24% = 5.20%; + a country premium of 3.98% (59.3% of operations in Egypt at 5.17%, 40.7% outside at 2.26%) -> Ke 28.09%.

[Cost of equity, what changed] the RETIRED construction multiplied the country premium by beta as well — rf* + beta x the TOTAL premium 9.41% = 30.44%, +235bp above this build. Beta measures a stock's exposure to its own equity market, not to its sovereign; charging a 1.22-beta company 22% more Egypt risk than the market is a separate claim and this study never made it. Alternatives still disclosed: rating basis 27.82%; the RETIRED un-netted construction 33.84% (audit trail only).

[WACC explicit] weights on NET financial debt 6.9% / equity 93.1% -> 26.65%. On gross debt the weights would be 18.3% / 81.7% -> 24.25%; the net-debt basis is used because it is the same quantity the enterprise-to-equity bridge subtracts, and it is the more conservative of the two.

[WACC terminal] Ke 16.87% (rf 10.50% READ FROM THE HOUSE PATH = 7.0% terminal inflation + 3.5% real convention, the SAME inflation the terminal growth of 9.1% is built on; + beta x mature premium 4.24% + country 2.13%); Kd after tax 6.70%; weights 85%/15% -> 15.34%

[Glide] forward WACC 26.65% -> 22.88% -> 19.74% -> 17.23% -> 15.34%; cumulative discount factors 0.7896, 0.6425, 0.5366, 0.4578, 0.3969. The glide fractions are the cost-of-debt path's own cumulative progress, so the shape is inherited rather than being a second free parameter.

[Segment build — the disclosed structure] Cables, Constructions and Electrical products and digital solutions, Note 5-3 revenue reconciling EXACTLY to the consolidated P&L in all three years. FY2025 revenue split: Cables 155,793 (55.4%), Constructions 90,959 (32.4%), Electrical products 34,298 (12.2%). Segment margins (profit / this revenue base) FY2023 -> FY2025: Cables 19.5% -> 13.5%; Constructions 11.6% -> 6.5%; Electrical products 25.4% -> 22.2%. Every segment compressed in FY2025; Cables and Constructions compressed the most.

[Corporate load — the bridge from segment profit to EBIT] (G&A + net impairment on receivables + other expenses - other income) / revenue: FY2023 5.70%, FY2024 4.30%, FY2025 3.16% — DECLINING, i.e. operating leverage improving at the corporate level even as segment margins fell. This reconciles EXACTLY: e.g. FY2025 segment profit 34,490 less the unallocated/corporate item of 247 = 34,243, less 3.16% x revenue 281,049 = 25,354, against the audited operating profit of 25,354.

[Forecast margins are OUTPUTS] gross margin 12.34% -> 12.51% -> 12.64% -> 12.71% -> 12.72%; EBITDA margin 10.34% -> 10.51% -> 10.64% -> 10.71% -> 10.72%. Segment mix FY2030E: Cables 53%, Constructions 30%, Electrical products 17%.

[FY2026 cross-check against the print] the disclosed Q1-2026 revenue of 75,298, grossed up on the Q1-2025 seasonal share of FY2025, implies a full year of 356,323. The build produces 370,194, +3.9% against it — an independent check that the segment build is not running ahead of the company's own trading.

[Q1-2026 EBITDA margin check] the disclosed Q1-2026 operating profit 8,247 on revenue 75,298 implies an EBITDA margin (at the model's D&A ratio) of 12.02%, against FY2026E's 10.34% — consistent, not contradicted.

[Currency split — two different questions] the audited Note 5-2 shows 40.7% of FY2025 revenue booked OUTSIDE Egypt, which is a geographic statement about where the customer sits. The model derives the share that is HARD-CURRENCY LINKED — dollar-priced by construction — at 51% in FY2025 and 51% -> 51% -> 51% -> 51% -> 51% thereafter, using segment-level export-intensity weights (Cables 65%, Constructions 30%, Electrical products 45%) rather than the blanket geographic split, because a project executed abroad for a local utility is foreign revenue but not necessarily dollar-priced. The LOWER figure is used everywhere the currency question is valued, because it is the conservative one.

[Segment mix, FY2026] each segment anchored on its OWN like-for-like half growth (note 16, both comparable halves): cables 30.57%, constructions 27.44%, electrical products 48.28%. The segment total grows 31.72% against the halves' own blended 31.92%; the difference is the FY2025 full-year mix differing from the H1-2025 mix and is not a disagreement about growth. THE RETIRED PATH forecast cables +47.60%, constructions +18.00% and electrical products +20.00% — right on the group to a third of a point and wrong on every segment, over-weighting the 11.4%-margin business and under-weighting the 23.6%-margin one

[Research pass, 10-Sep-2026] the company's Q2-2026 presentation puts 79% of group sales outside Egypt and from exports, against 84% in wires and cables and 67% in engineering and construction, each up nine points on the quarter. This study's hard-currency weights are 65% and 30%. IT DOES NOT FOLLOW THAT THE WEIGHTS ARE TOO LOW, because the published measure counts exports out of Egypt as well as sales booked abroad and the weights are about currency of invoicing. What it does establish is the DIRECTION and the ceiling, and the direction is one this study is already on the conservative side of. Raising the hard-currency share would move the currency-of-discounting alternative FURTHER BELOW the central, not toward the market, because that alternative deflates the hard-currency leg at each year's exchange rate before discounting it.

THE THREE ANNOUNCED PLANTS ARE ALREADY PAID FOR IN THIS MODEL AND ALREADY EARNING IN IT. On 24 June 2026 the company announced a copper-recycling complex (US$80mn, 20,000 t/yr of scrap into cathode), a copper-tube plant (US$65mn, 15,000 t/yr) and an aluminium-rod line (US$55mn, 50,000 t/yr, output targeted entirely at export), all opening in the first quarter of 2028. That is about US$200mn, roughly EGP 11bn at the forecast rate, against a capital-expenditure path of EGP 13,232 rising to 23,057 million a year and EGP 91,451 million across the window. The spend is inside the path and the output is inside segment growth rates anchored on the company's own reviewed half, so adding a revenue line for them would COUNT THE SAME GROWTH TWICE. Nothing is added, and that is a finding rather than an omission.

WHAT DID NOT SURVIVE TRACING. An 8-12% cash rebate on export FOB value for high-local-content exporters was reported as a live entitlement; the programme is real and dated, but NEITHER PASS COULD NAME THIS COMPANY AS A BENEFICIARY AND NEITHER COULD QUANTIFY A RATE FOR IT, and the two disagreed on the budget itself (EGP 45bn against EGP 48bn). Nothing enters. A margin of 5.3-5.4% was reported for the engineering segment in late 2025; the AUDITED FY2025 segment note gives 6.45%, and an audited figure is not displaced by a research summary. The two passes also disagreed on the cables backlog, one putting it at EGP 52.6bn in the first quarter and the other at 43.5bn at 30 June; the study reads the issuer's own releases and carries 43.5bn.

[Forecast interest] net finance cost path 1,743 -> 2,116 -> 2,159 -> 1,769 -> 1,172 as the cash pile builds against a broadly static gross debt book. Surplus cash is assumed to yield 10% — a deliberate blend of Egyptian-pound deposit rates (~19-20%, falling) and hard-currency cash (~4-5%); the positive carry over the hard-currency-heavy debt book (7.7-9.5%) is real economics (borrow dollars cheap, hold pounds dear), disclosed rather than hidden. Payout ratio 25% — struck at the ACTUAL FY2025 payout: EGP 1.85/share ratified by the AGM on 6 May 2026 and paid from 4 June 2026 = 22.8% of FY2025 attributable EPS, up from 12.3% a year earlier.
[Terminal return on capital] taken as next year's NOPAT over the closing invested capital (22.4%), the standard convention, rather than the same year's NOPAT over closing capital (20.6%).

[Terminal growth reconciliation] historical ROIC 22.3% / 24.9% / 21.0%; reinvestment rate 20.1% / 30.4% / 51.5%; implied g 4.5% / 7.6% / 10.8%. Check (a): actual NOPAT CAGR FY23-FY25 = +26.9%. Check (b): implied g from STABLE years only (FY24 excluded as a debt-funded capacity burst, reinvestment 30%) = 7.6%. Adopted terminal g 9.1%.

[Effective tax rate, the whole disclosed path] FY2023 31.32% / FY2024 30.13% / FY2025 22.57% / Q1-2026 25.75% / H1-2026 30.85%, and the SECOND QUARTER ALONE therefore 35.15% — the half's tax of 4,749 less the quarter's 1,813, over the half's pre-tax 15,392 less the quarter's 7,042. The adopted forecast rate of 24.5% sits BELOW all four of the most recent readings. It is not raised here — one half is not a five-year forecast — but it is priced in section 1.9 and discussed, which earlier editions did not do.

[Terminal value, sanctioned construction] FY2030E NOPAT 47,002 — the LAST EXPLICIT YEAR's, ungrown, because the module grows the finished cash flow itself and handing it an already-grown figure would overstate the terminal by exactly one year of growth — + book D&A 6,902 - maintenance at replacement cost 12,377 (on the DERIVED 17.26-year life) - growth capital 4,573 (growth capital at the stated real terminal growth) - inflation on working capital 8,882 = FCFF 28,072. TV 493,872 at 15.34% and 9.1% nominal, discounted at the YEAR-5 factor 0.3969 -> PV 195,998, 89% of enterprise value. Implied payout of terminal NOPAT 59.7%; TV against the NOPAT-perpetuity floor +61.2%.

[Terminal value, the RETIRED construction, published unused] g x IC on the same inputs gives 490,003 (-0.8%), charging 20,901 a year for ever — an implied replacement cycle of 10.9 years against the 17.26 this company's own note 17 derives. Recorded so the change is visible, and it feeds nothing.

[Terminal ceiling] the domestic leg is 49% of FY30E revenue; a blended long-run nominal ceiling is 11.2% (15% Egyptian nominal on the domestic leg, 7.5% world nominal on the export leg). Adopted g of 9% sits below it.
[Associates] carried at the audited FY2025 carrying value of 6,758 — the actual closing balance, not the prior year's carrying value scaled by an assumed growth factor. (Reviewed 30-Jun-2026: 7,120.)

[Net debt, and why the June sheet is NOT used] the bridge deducts 20,560 at 31-Dec-2025, the date this valuation is struck at. The reviewed 30-Jun-2026 sheet shows 28,629, +8,069 over the half — and that deterioration is the same working-capital absorption the model's own FY2026 forecast already carries (a working-capital movement of 16,965 against capex of 13,232, giving free cash flow to the firm of -319 in the first forecast year). Deducting it in the bridge as well would charge one cash outflow twice.

[Employees' statutory share of profit] measured at 11.60% (FY2024), 11.96% (FY2025) and 13.01% (H1-2026) of profit attributable to owners; mean 12.19%. It is disclosed only in the earnings-per-share note, below the attributable line, and appears in NO line of the income statement — which is why the first edition, whose cost stack is built from unit economics, could not have caught it there. Equity attributable 185,519 less 22,620 = 162,899. THE RECONCILIATION THAT SHOULD HAVE EXPOSED IT: this study registered FY2025 attributable profit of 17,330.245 and the reported EPS of 7.13; 17,330.245 / 2,140.777876 = 8.095, and the difference is this charge plus the ESOP adjustment to the weighted-average count.

[Bridge] EV 219,193 - net financial debt 20,560 + associates at carrying value 6,758 = 205,391; less minority interests at their 9.7% share of group profit = 19,872; less the employees' statutory share of profit at 12.19% = 22,620 -> equity attributable to ORDINARY SHAREHOLDERS 162,899 = EGP 76.09/share AT 31-DEC-2025; rolled 246/365 of a year to the 3-Sep-2026 anchor at the 28.1% cost of equity (x1.1816) less the EGP 1.85 dividend paid in the window = EGP 87.94/share against a spot of 130.00 (-32%).

[Currency-of-discounting alternative — UIP-corrected] the hard-currency leg (51% of cash flow) is first DEFLATED to dollars at each year's exchange rate, discounted at a USD cost of capital of 11.34% with 3.5% terminal growth, and only then translated back. Corrected result EGP 77.86/share (-40% vs spot).

[Rating-basis alternative, WHAT THE RETIRED CONSTRUCTION GAVE] Ke 33.02% (beta through the whole 13.94% premium) and a terminal built on today's beta through a premium raised by a typed 4.5 points -> 21.90%, giving EGP 33.67. kd_integrity.currency_source: BACK-SOLVED FROM TWO DISCLOSED RATES, NOT ASSUMED. The audited FY2025 consolidated financial statements disclose the weighted average interest rate on Egyptian-pound financial liabilities (21.30%) and on US-dollar and other foreign-currency financial liabilities (5.29%). The independently computed blended effective rate of 9.84% then pins the pound share at 28.4% and the foreign-currency share at 71.6% by arithmetic -- down sharply from the roughly 44% pound share the same construction implied a year earlier, when the disclosed pound rate was 28.68%. THE COMPOSITION IS ESTABLISHED BEFORE THE RATE IS SET, which is what makes the sovereign floor's own qualifier -- 'on an all-local-currency book' -- reachable on this name instead of behaving as though those four words were not there.
kd_integrity.interest_bearing_note: The effective rate's denominator is AVERAGE INTEREST-BEARING BORROWINGS -- opening 58,797 and closing 62,462 loans and credit facilities from the audited FY2025 borrowings movement note -- and the numerator is the finance charge on those borrowings, 5,967. It is NOT total liabilities: supplier balances, contract liabilities, retentions and accruals bear no interest, and dividing the charge by a total that includes them understates the rate by a multiple and manufactures a bias that looks exactly like evidence.
kd_integrity.effective_rate_unavailable: ONE PERIOD, AND THE REASON IS A DISCLOSURE GAP RATHER THAN AN OVERSIGHT. An independently computed effective rate needs a finance charge and the opening and closing balances of the borrowings that bear it. The audited FY2025 consolidated financial statements disclose the borrowings movement reconciliation that supplies the denominator; the FY2024 statements disclose net finance costs rather than the interest charge on borrowings alone, and the Q1-2026 and H1-2026 reviewed interim statements disclose no comparable movement reconciliation at all. So a second independently computed period cannot be built from what this company has published, and it is not manufactured: a rate interpolated to satisfy a count corrupts the very check it is being computed for. The disclosed contractual rates for FY2024 (28.68% on the pound book) and Q1-2026 (20.32%) are held beside it as corroboration and are NOT presented as independently computed.

Against the audited FY2025 year of 12.2719% the forecast opens only -0.57% low and nothing would fire -- the stale full-year rate is the flattering comparison, which is why it is not the one this record is struck on.
